q: 我平时___喝冷水，对胃不好。
zh: 我平时不喝冷水，对胃不好。
py: wǒ píng shí bù hē lěng shuǐ duì wèi bù hǎo
en: I don't usually drink cold water; it's bad for the stomach.
why: 平时 marks a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one single occasion that did not happen.

q: 明天我___去医院，我已经好了。
zh: 明天我不去医院，我已经好了。
py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù yī yuàn wǒ yǐ jīng hǎo le
en: I'm not going to the hospital tomorrow; I'm already better.
why: 明天 is the future and this is a decision, so 不. 没 only looks back at what has not happened so far.

q: 我小时候___吃药，妈妈每次都要哄我。
zh: 我小时候不吃药，妈妈每次都要哄我。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù chī yào mā ma měi cì dōu yào hǒng wǒ
en: When I was little I wouldn't take medicine; Mum had to coax me every time.
why: 每次 turns this into a past habit and refusal, which takes 不 even though the time is past. 没 would say one particular dose was missed.

q: 我今晚___熬夜了，要早点睡。
zh: 我今晚不熬夜了，要早点睡。
py: wǒ jīn wǎn bù áo yè le yào zǎo diǎn shuì
en: I won't stay up late tonight; I'm going to bed early.
why: 今晚 with a decision to sleep early is a plan, so 不. 没 cannot negate a future event.

q: 医生让我少吃盐，所以我以后___做太咸的菜，也不点外卖了。
zh: 医生让我少吃盐，所以我以后不做太咸的菜，也不点外卖了。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ shǎo chī yán suǒ yǐ wǒ yǐ hòu bù zuò tài xián de cài yě bù diǎn wài mài le
en: The doctor told me to eat less salt, so from now on I won't cook overly salty dishes or order takeout.
why: 以后 looks forward: a resolution takes 不. 没 would claim you did not cook salty food on some past occasion.

q: 明年夏天我打算戒掉甜饮料，一杯奶茶也___喝。
zh: 明年夏天我打算戒掉甜饮料，一杯奶茶也不喝。
py: míng nián xià tiān wǒ dǎ suàn jiè diào tián yǐn liào yī bēi nǎi chá yě bù hē
en: Next summer I plan to give up sweet drinks; I won't drink even one cup of milk tea.
why: The time is next summer and it is a plan, so 不. 没 is only for what has not happened up to now.

q: 昨天天气很好，一点儿也___冷。
zh: 昨天天气很好，一点儿也不冷。
py: zuó tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo yī diǎn r yě bù lěng
en: The weather was nice yesterday; it wasn't cold at all.
why: 冷 is an adjective, a quality rather than an event, so it takes 不 even for yesterday.

q: 这个手机___是我的，是我姐姐的。
zh: 这个手机不是我的，是我姐姐的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ de shì wǒ jiě jie de
en: This phone isn't mine; it's my older sister's.
why: 是 is only ever negated with 不. 没是 does not exist.

q: 我___认识这个医生，你认识吗？
zh: 我不认识这个医生，你认识吗？
py: wǒ bù rèn shi zhè ge yī shēng nǐ rèn shi ma
en: I don't know this doctor; do you?
why: 认识 is a state verb, so 不. 没认识 is not said.

q: 我以前___知道手机也能当钱包用。
zh: 我以前不知道手机也能当钱包用。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào shǒu jī yě néng dāng qián bāo yòng
en: I didn't know before that a phone can serve as a wallet.
why: 知道 is a state, so it takes 不 even with 以前. 没知道 is a common learner slip.

q: 昨天的检查结果___太好，医生让我再来一次。
zh: 昨天的检查结果不太好，医生让我再来一次。
py: zuó tiān de jiǎn chá jié guǒ bú tài hǎo yī shēng ràng wǒ zài lái yī cì
en: Yesterday's test results weren't great, so the doctor asked me to come again.
why: 好 here is a quality of the results, so 不太好. 没太好 would sound like something has not recovered.

q: 手机屏幕太脏了，视频一点也___清楚。
zh: 手机屏幕太脏了，视频一点也不清楚。
py: shǒu jī píng mù tài zāng le shì pín yī diǎn yě bù qīng chu
en: The phone screen is so dirty that the video isn't clear at all.
why: 清楚 is an adjective describing how the picture looks, so 不. 没 would need an event.

q: 直到上个月我才知道自己对花粉过敏，以前我一点也___知道。
zh: 直到上个月我才知道自己对花粉过敏，以前我一点也不知道。
py: zhí dào shàng ge yuè wǒ cái zhī dào zì jǐ duì huā fěn guò mǐn yǐ qián wǒ yī diǎn yě bù zhī dào
en: I only found out last month that I'm allergic to pollen; I never knew before.
why: 知道 is a state, so the negative is 不, and 一点也 strengthens it: 一点也不知道. 没知道 is a common learner slip, even with a past time word.

q: 我___会用这个软件，你教教我吧。
zh: 我不会用这个软件，你教教我吧。
py: wǒ bú huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn nǐ jiāo jiao wǒ ba
en: I don't know how to use this app; please teach me.
why: 会 is a modal verb and takes 不. 没会 is impossible.

q: 医生说我现在___能喝咖啡。
zh: 医生说我现在不能喝咖啡。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ xiàn zài bù néng hē kā fēi
en: The doctor says I can't drink coffee right now.
why: 能 is a modal, negated with 不 before it. 没能 means "failed to", which does not fit a rule from the doctor.

q: 我现在头疼，___想出门。
zh: 我现在头疼，不想出门。
py: wǒ xiàn zài tóu téng bù xiǎng chū mén
en: I have a headache now and don't want to go out.
why: 想 (want to) is a modal, and 现在 is a present state, so 不想. 没想 would be about not having thought of something.

q: 在飞机上手机___可以打电话，要调成飞行模式。
zh: 在飞机上手机不可以打电话，要调成飞行模式。
py: zài fēi jī shàng shǒu jī bù kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà yào tiáo chéng fēi xíng mó shì
en: On a plane you may not make phone calls; set the phone to flight mode.
why: 可以 is a permission modal and is negated with 不. 没可以 does not exist.

q: 你发烧了，___应该去上班，在家休息吧。
zh: 你发烧了，不应该去上班，在家休息吧。
py: nǐ fā shāo le bù yīng gāi qù shàng bān zài jiā xiū xi ba
en: You have a fever; you shouldn't go to work. Rest at home.
why: 应该 is a modal, so 不应该. 没应该 is never said.

q: 虽然医生反复解释过，他还是___愿意做手术，担心有风险。
zh: 虽然医生反复解释过，他还是不愿意做手术，担心有风险。
py: suī rán yī shēng fǎn fù jiě shì guo tā hái shi bù yuàn yì zuò shǒu shù dān xīn yǒu fēng xiǎn
en: Although the doctor explained it again and again, he is still unwilling to have the operation, as he worries about the risk.
why: 愿意 is a modal and keeps 不 even in a past setting. 没愿意 is not natural.

q: 奶奶___用智能手机，我来教她。
zh: 奶奶不会用智能手机，我来教她。
py: nǎi nai bú huì yòng zhì néng shǒu jī wǒ lái jiāo tā
en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a smartphone; I'll teach her.
why: 不 goes before the modal 会. 会不用 would put the negative on the main verb and does not make this meaning.

q: 我昨天___去上班，因为我发烧了。
zh: 我昨天没去上班，因为我发烧了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù shàng bān yīn wèi wǒ fā shāo le
en: I didn't go to work yesterday because I had a fever.
why: A specific past day on which the action did not happen needs 没. 不去 would be a refusal or a plan.

q: 医生还___来，我们再等一等。
zh: 医生还没来，我们再等一等。
py: yī shēng hái méi lái wǒ men zài děng yi děng
en: The doctor hasn't come yet; let's wait a bit longer.
why: 还没 means "not yet", something expected has not happened. 还不来 would be an impatient complaint, not a report.

q: 我的手机昨晚没电了，我___给你打电话。
zh: 我的手机昨晚没电了，我没给你打电话。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī zuó wǎn méi diàn le wǒ méi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: My phone died last night, so I didn't call you.
why: 昨晚 is a finished time and the call did not happen, so 没. 不 would suggest you refused to call.

q: 我从来___在网上买过药。
zh: 我从来没在网上买过药。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi zài wǎng shàng mǎi guo yào
en: I have never bought medicine online.
why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now, so its negative is 没. 不 cannot go with 过.

q: 妈妈___在看手机，她在看书。
zh: 妈妈没在看手机，她在看书。
py: mā ma méi zài kàn shǒu jī tā zài kàn shū
en: Mum isn't looking at her phone; she's reading.
why: Negating an action in progress (在 + verb) takes 没. 不 would sound like she habitually refuses to.

q: 这个软件我下载了，但是还___用过。
zh: 这个软件我下载了，但是还没用过。
py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn wǒ xià zài le dàn shì hái méi yòng guo
en: I downloaded this app but haven't used it yet.
why: 还没 + verb + 过 is "have not yet". 不 cannot combine with 过.

q: 到现在为止，我还___收到医院发来的检查报告。
zh: 到现在为止，我还没收到医院发来的检查报告。
py: dào xiàn zài wéi zhǐ wǒ hái méi shōu dào yī yuàn fā lái de jiǎn chá bào gào
en: So far I haven't received the test report from the hospital.
why: 到现在为止 plus 还 says it has not happened yet, so 没. 不收到 is not possible.

q: 他这辈子___住过院，所以很怕去医院。
zh: 他这辈子没住过院，所以很怕去医院。
py: tā zhè bèi zi méi zhù guo yuàn suǒ yǐ hěn pà qù yī yuàn
en: He has never been in hospital in his life, so he is afraid of going.
why: 住过院 is a lifetime experience, so 没 + verb + 过. 不 cannot be used with 过.

q: 我家___有网络，所以不能上网。
zh: 我家没有网络，所以不能上网。
py: wǒ jiā méi yǒu wǎng luò suǒ yǐ bù néng shàng wǎng
en: We have no internet at home, so I can't get online.
why: 有 is only negated with 没. 不有 does not exist.

q: 医院旁边___有银行，只有一家药店。
zh: 医院旁边没有银行，只有一家药店。
py: yī yuàn páng biān méi yǒu yín háng zhǐ yǒu yī jiā yào diàn
en: There is no bank next to the hospital, only a pharmacy.
why: Existence 有 is negated with 没有, never 不有.

q: 你有___有这个软件的账号？
zh: 你有没有这个软件的账号？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de zhàng hào
en: Do you have an account for this app?
why: The A-not-A question for 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is not said.

q: 下个星期我___有时间去体检，下个月再说吧。
zh: 下个星期我没有时间去体检，下个月再说吧。
py: xià ge xīng qī wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān qù tǐ jiǎn xià ge yuè zài shuō ba
en: I won't have time for a check-up next week; let's talk about it next month.
why: Even for the future, 有 is negated with 没有. 不有时间 is wrong.

q: 这个房间里___有信号，你去阳台打电话吧。
zh: 这个房间里没有信号，你去阳台打电话吧。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu xìn hào nǐ qù yáng tái dǎ diàn huà ba
en: There's no signal in this room; go make the call on the balcony.
why: "There is no signal" is 没有 + noun. 不有 is never used.

q: 他的手机里一个游戏也___有，只有几个学习软件。
zh: 他的手机里一个游戏也没有，只有几个学习软件。
py: tā de shǒu jī lǐ yī gè yóu xì yě méi yǒu zhǐ yǒu jǐ gè xué xí ruǎn jiàn
en: There isn't a single game on his phone, only a few study apps.
why: 一个...也 plus 有 is negated with 没有. 不有 is never possible.

q: 如果明天你___有空，我们就改成视频会议。
zh: 如果明天你没有空，我们就改成视频会议。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān nǐ méi yǒu kòng wǒ men jiù gǎi chéng shì pín huì yì
en: If you're not free tomorrow, we'll switch to a video meeting.
why: 有空 is built on 有, so its negative is 没有空 even in a future condition. 不有空 is wrong.

q: 听说那家诊所晚上___有医生值班，所以病人只能去大医院。
zh: 听说那家诊所晚上没有医生值班，所以病人只能去大医院。
py: tīng shuō nà jiā zhěn suǒ wǎn shang méi yǒu yī shēng zhí bān suǒ yǐ bìng rén zhǐ néng qù dà yī yuàn
en: I hear that clinic has no doctor on duty at night, so patients can only go to the big hospital.
why: The clause says no doctor exists on duty, which is 没有. 不有 is never used.

q: 他昨天没来上课___。
zh: 他昨天没来上课。
py: tā zuó tiān méi lái shàng kè
en: He didn't come to class yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is no 了. Adding 了 is the typical error.

q: 我今天没吃药___，一会儿再吃。
zh: 我今天没吃药，一会儿再吃。
py: wǒ jīn tiān méi chī yào yī huì r zài chī
en: I haven't taken my medicine today; I'll take it in a bit.
why: The negative of a completed action drops 了: 没吃药.

q: 弟弟昨晚没玩游戏___，他早早就睡了。
zh: 弟弟昨晚没玩游戏，他早早就睡了。
py: dì di zuó wǎn méi wán yóu xì tā zǎo zǎo jiù shuì le
en: My younger brother didn't play games last night; he went to bed early.
why: The first clause is a negated completed action: 没 replaces 了. The later 睡了 is a different, positive clause.

q: 他昨天没带手机___，所以没接到你的电话。
zh: 他昨天没带手机，所以没接到你的电话。
py: tā zuó tiān méi dài shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi jiē dào nǐ de diàn huà
en: He didn't bring his phone yesterday, so he didn't get your call.
why: 没带手机 is complete without 了; 了 does not follow 没 to mark a finished event.

q: 她今天早上没量体温___，护士提醒了她。
zh: 她今天早上没量体温，护士提醒了她。
py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang méi liáng tǐ wēn hù shi tí xǐng le tā
en: She didn't take her temperature this morning, and the nurse reminded her.
why: The omitted action is negated with 没 and no 了. The 了 after 提醒 belongs to a different, completed action.

q: 我昨天没给他发照片___，手机坏了。
zh: 我昨天没给他发照片，手机坏了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi tā fā zhào piàn shǒu jī huài le
en: I didn't send him the photos yesterday because my phone broke.
why: 发照片 did not happen, so 没 and no 了.

q: 老板上午没批准他请假___，他只好带病去上班。
zh: 老板上午没批准他请假，他只好带病去上班。
py: lǎo bǎn shàng wǔ méi pī zhǔn tā qǐng jià tā zhǐ hǎo dài bìng qù shàng bān
en: The boss didn't approve his leave this morning, so he had to go to work sick.
why: The approval did not take place: 没批准 with no 了. 没...了 here would suggest a changed situation.

q: 我昨天忘了充电，所以今天早上手机没响___，上班迟到了。
zh: 我昨天忘了充电，所以今天早上手机没响，上班迟到了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān wàng le chōng diàn suǒ yǐ jīn tiān zǎo shang shǒu jī méi xiǎng shàng bān chí dào le
en: I forgot to charge it yesterday, so my phone didn't ring this morning and I was late for work.
why: This morning is a specific past event that did not happen, so 没响 with no 了. The 了 on 忘了 and 迟到了 belong to completed actions.

q: 他说他今天___来了，他不舒服。
zh: 他说他今天不来了，他不舒服。
py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái le tā bù shū fu
en: He says he isn't coming today; he doesn't feel well.
why: The English is a decision, "isn't coming", so 不来. 没来 would report that he did not show up.

q: 我们等了一个小时，医生还是___来。
zh: 我们等了一个小时，医生还是没来。
py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí yī shēng hái shi méi lái
en: We waited an hour and the doctor still didn't come.
why: 等了一个小时 is a past event and "didn't come" reports a fact, so 没. 不来 would mean the doctor refuses to come.

q: 弟弟一听要吃药就摇头，说什么也___吃。
zh: 弟弟一听要吃药就摇头，说什么也不吃。
py: dì di yī tīng yào chī yào jiù yáo tóu shuō shén me yě bù chī
en: My brother shakes his head at the mention of medicine and won't take it no matter what.
why: 说什么也 plus a refusal means "no matter what, I won't", so 不吃. 没吃 would only report that he did not take it, and cannot follow 说什么也.

q: 他昨天说他今天___来，可是今天一早他就到了。
zh: 他昨天说他今天不来，可是今天一早他就到了。
py: tā zuó tiān shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái kě shì jīn tiān yī zǎo tā jiù dào le
en: Yesterday he said he wasn't coming today, but he arrived first thing this morning.
why: What he said was a plan for today, "wouldn't come", so 不来. 没来 would contradict that he arrived.

q: 我今天早上___吃早饭，所以现在肚子很饿。
zh: 我今天早上没吃早饭，所以现在肚子很饿。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi chī zǎo fàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài dù zi hěn è
en: I didn't have breakfast this morning, so I'm very hungry now.
why: This morning is a finished event that did not happen, so 没. 不吃 would mean you do not eat breakfast as a rule.

q: 我___吃辣的，吃了会胃疼。
zh: 我不吃辣的，吃了会胃疼。
py: wǒ bù chī là de chī le huì wèi téng
en: I don't eat spicy food; it gives me a stomachache.
why: The second clause 吃了会胃疼 gives a standing reason, so this is a habit: 不. 没 would be one meal.

q: 我昨天给他打了三次电话，可他一次也___接。
zh: 我昨天给他打了三次电话，可他一次也没接。
py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi tā dǎ le sān cì diàn huà kě tā yī cì yě méi jiē
en: I called him three times yesterday, but he didn't pick up even once.
why: These are three specific past calls, so 没接. 一次也不接 would be a general refusal.

q: 妹妹从小就___吃青菜，现在也是。
zh: 妹妹从小就不吃青菜，现在也是。
py: mèi mei cóng xiǎo jiù bù chī qīng cài xiàn zài yě shì
en: My younger sister has never eaten greens since she was little, and still doesn't.
why: 从小就...现在也是 describes a lifelong habit, so 不. 没 would report a single missed meal.

q: 医生建议他住院观察，但他觉得没必要，所以决定___住院。
zh: 医生建议他住院观察，但他觉得没必要，所以决定不住院。
py: yī shēng jiàn yì tā zhù yuàn guān chá dàn tā jué de méi bì yào suǒ yǐ jué dìng bù zhù yuàn
en: The doctor suggested he stay in hospital for observation, but he felt it was unnecessary, so he decided not to be admitted.
why: 决定 introduces a decision, so 不. 没 cannot follow 决定.

q: 视频会议开始了十分钟，老板还___出现，大家只好先讨论。
zh: 视频会议开始了十分钟，老板还没出现，大家只好先讨论。
py: shì pín huì yì kāi shǐ le shí fēn zhōng lǎo bǎn hái méi chū xiàn dà jiā zhǐ hǎo xiān tǎo lùn
en: Ten minutes into the video meeting the boss still hadn't appeared, so everyone started discussing first.
why: 还没 reports that something expected has not happened by now. 还不出现 would sound like he refuses to appear.

q: 这段话太难了，就算再听一遍，我也___。
zh: 这段话太难了，就算再听一遍，我也听不懂。
py: zhè duàn huà tài nán le jiù suàn zài tīng yī biàn wǒ yě tīng bù dǒng
en: This passage is so hard that even if I listened once more, I still wouldn't understand.
why: A hypothetical "even if I listen again" is about ability: verb + 不 + result. 没听懂 only reports a past failure.

q: 对不起，我昨天___看懂你的短信。
zh: 对不起，我昨天没看懂你的短信。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn dǒng nǐ de duǎn xìn
en: Sorry, I didn't understand your text message yesterday.
why: A result not reached on a past day is 没 + verb + result. 不看懂 is wrong.

q: 昨天我翻遍了包，也___找到我的充电器。
zh: 昨天我翻遍了包，也没找到我的充电器。
py: zuó tiān wǒ fān biàn le bāo yě méi zhǎo dào wǒ de chōng diàn qì
en: Yesterday I searched my whole bag and still didn't find my charger.
why: 昨天 is a specific past search that did not reach its result: 没找到. 不找到 is not a pattern.

q: 手机屏幕裂了，现在什么都___清楚。
zh: 手机屏幕裂了，现在什么都看不清楚。
py: shǒu jī píng mù liè le xiàn zài shén me dōu kàn bù qīng chu
en: The phone screen is cracked, so now I can't see anything clearly.
why: 现在 is about ability caused by the cracked screen: verb + 不 + result. 没看清楚 would report one past glance.

q: 这颗药太大了，我吞___下去。
zh: 这颗药太大了，我吞不下去。
py: zhè kē yào tài dà le wǒ tūn bu xià qù
en: This pill is so big that I can't swallow it.
why: 太大了 gives the reason for an inability, so 吞不下去. 没 would report a past attempt.

q: 我的手机还___充满电，再等十分钟。
zh: 我的手机还没充满电，再等十分钟。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī hái méi chōng mǎn diàn zài děng shí fēn zhōng
en: My phone hasn't finished charging yet; wait ten more minutes.
why: 还没 + verb + result says the result is not yet reached. 不充满 does not fit here.

q: 我腿疼得厉害，走___远，你们先去吧。
zh: 我腿疼得厉害，走不远，你们先去吧。
py: wǒ tuǐ téng de lì hai zǒu bù yuǎn nǐ men xiān qù ba
en: My leg hurts badly and I can't walk far; you go ahead.
why: The reason is a present inability, so verb + 不 + result. 走没远 is not said.

q: 我的邮件发出去了，但对方的回复我还___看到。
zh: 我的邮件发出去了，但对方的回复我还没看到。
py: wǒ de yóu jiàn fā chū qù le dàn duì fāng de huí fù wǒ hái méi kàn dào
en: My email has gone out, but I haven't seen the other side's reply yet.
why: 还没 + verb + result: the result has not been reached yet. 不看到 is wrong.

q: 上课的时候请___玩手机。
zh: 上课的时候请别玩手机。
py: shàng kè de shí hou qǐng bié wán shǒu jī
en: Please don't play on your phone during class.
why: A request not to do something takes 别 (or 不要). 没 is not an imperative, and 不用 means "no need".

q: 药我已经买好了，你___再去药店了。
zh: 药我已经买好了，你不用再去药店了。
py: yào wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le nǐ bú yòng zài qù yào diàn le
en: I've already bought the medicine; you don't need to go to the pharmacy again.
why: The reason is that it is already done, so the point is "no need": 不用. 别 would be a prohibition.

q: 手机快没电了，你___再玩游戏了。
zh: 手机快没电了，你别再玩游戏了。
py: shǒu jī kuài méi diàn le nǐ bié zài wán yóu xì le
en: Your phone is almost dead; stop playing games.
why: This tells someone to stop doing something, and 别...了 is the stop-it pattern. 不用 would only say "no need".

q: 孩子睡着了，你___大声说话。
zh: 孩子睡着了，你别大声说话。
py: hái zi shuì zháo le nǐ bié dà shēng shuō huà
en: The child is asleep; don't speak loudly.
why: An order needs 别 or 不要. Bare 不 would only state that you do not speak loudly.

q: 他在开车，你___给他打电话。
zh: 他在开车，你别给他打电话。
py: tā zài kāi chē nǐ bié gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
en: He's driving; don't call him.
why: A prohibition takes 别. 没 reports the past and cannot be an order.

q: 医生说你的病已经好了，___再吃药了。
zh: 医生说你的病已经好了，不用再吃药了。
py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de bìng yǐ jīng hǎo le bú yòng zài chī yào le
en: The doctor says you're better, so you don't need to take any more medicine.
why: Reporting that something is no longer needed is 不用...了. 别 would be an order and clash with the doctor having said you recovered.

q: 睡觉前___看手机，对眼睛不好，也会睡不着。
zh: 睡觉前别看手机，对眼睛不好，也会睡不着。
py: shuì jiào qián bié kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jing bù hǎo yě huì shuì bù zháo
en: Don't look at your phone before bed; it's bad for your eyes and you won't be able to sleep.
why: Advice against doing something is 别 + verb. 不用 would say it is unnecessary, and 没 is not an imperative.

q: 你___哭了，医生说只是小手术。
zh: 你别哭了，医生说只是小手术。
py: nǐ bié kū le yī shēng shuō zhǐ shì xiǎo shǒu shù
en: Stop crying; the doctor says it's only a minor operation.
why: 别...了 tells someone to stop. 不用哭了 would sound like "there is no need to cry", not a comfort.

zh: 我昨天没吃早饭。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi chī zǎo fàn
en: I didn't have breakfast yesterday.
why: 没 goes right before the verb it negates, after the time word and subject. The time word may sit before or after 我.

zh: 医生今天不在医院。
py: yī shēng jīn tiān bú zài yī yuàn
en: The doctor isn't at the hospital today.
why: 不在 + place is the standard negative of 在. The time word can come before or after the subject, but 不在 stays before the place.

zh: 睡觉前别看手机。
py: shuì jiào qián bié kàn shǒu jī
en: Don't look at your phone before bed.
why: 别 must sit right before the verb it forbids, and the time phrase may come before or after 别. 别 cannot go after 看.

zh: 这位医生的电话我没有。
py: zhè wèi yī shēng de diàn huà wǒ méi yǒu
en: I don't have this doctor's phone number.
why: 没有 negates 有 and sits right before or after its noun phrase in a topic-comment order. 不有 is never possible.

zh: 医生说我现在不能喝咖啡。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ xiàn zài bù néng hē kā fēi
en: The doctor says I can't drink coffee at the moment.
why: 不 sits before the modal 能, not before 喝. 现在 can sit before or after 我, or open the sentence.

zh: 上课时请不要玩手机。
py: shàng kè shí qǐng bú yào wán shǒu jī
en: Please don't play on your phone during class.
why: 不要 goes right before the verb phrase it forbids. 上课时 may come before or after 请.

zh: 我昨天没带手机出门。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi dài shǒu jī chū mén
en: I didn't take my phone when I went out yesterday.
why: 没 goes right before 带 and no 了 appears. The time word may precede or follow 我, and 出门 may come before 没带手机 or after it.

zh: 他写的字我都看不懂。
py: tā xiě de zì wǒ dōu kàn bù dǒng
en: I can't read any of his handwriting.
why: 看不懂 keeps 不 between the verb and its result. 都 comes right before it. The topic phrase may come first or last.

zh: 他说明天不来公司。
py: tā shuō míng tiān bù lái gōng sī
en: He says he isn't coming to the office tomorrow.
why: 明天 is a plan, so 不 goes before 来, after the time word in the reported clause.

zh: 这家诊所周末没有医生。
py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ zhōu mò méi yǒu yī shēng
en: This clinic has no doctor on weekends.
why: 没有 + noun for non-existence. The time word can come before or after the subject.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
zh: 我昨天没去医院。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù yī yuàn
en: I didn't go to the hospital yesterday.
why: Negating a completed action swaps 了 for 没: 没去 with no 了.

zh: 我不能上网。
py: wǒ bù néng shàng wǎng
en: I can't get online.
why: The modal 能 is negated with 不. 没能 would mean "did not manage to", a different sentence.

src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le tā de huà
zh: 我听不懂他的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
en: I can't understand what he says.
why: "Cannot" is verb + 不 + result: 听不懂. 没听懂 would only say you did not understand.

src_py: tā zài chuáng shàng wán shǒu jī
zh: 别在床上玩手机。
py: bié zài chuáng shàng wán shǒu jī
en: Don't play on your phone in bed.
why: A prohibition is 别 + verb phrase. The 在 phrase stays after 别, before the verb.

zh: 我没有信号。
py: wǒ méi yǒu xìn hào
en: I have no signal.
why: 有 is negated only with 没有. 不有 does not exist.

s: 我的手机不有电了。
s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù yǒu diàn le
zh: 我的手机没有电了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi yǒu diàn le
en: My phone has no battery left.
why: 有 is only ever negated with 没; 不有 does not exist.

s: 你有没有这个软件的账号？
s_py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de zhàng hào
zh: 你有没有这个软件的账号？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de zhàng hào
en: Do you have an account for this app?
why: 有没有 is the correct A-not-A question for 有, so this is right even though 没 looks past-tense.

s: 他昨天没去了医院。
s_py: tā zuó tiān méi qù le yī yuàn
zh: 他昨天没去医院。
py: tā zuó tiān méi qù yī yuàn
en: He didn't go to the hospital yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so 了 cannot follow the verb.

s: 我已经三天没发烧了。
s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi fā shāo le
zh: 我已经三天没发烧了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi fā shāo le
en: I haven't had a fever for three days.
why: 没...了 with a length of time is correct: it says how long since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action.

s: 我从来不住过院。
s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù zhù guo yuàn
zh: 我从来没住过院。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi zhù guo yuàn
en: I have never been in hospital.
why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now and is negated with 没. 不 cannot combine with 过.

s: 她没在打电话，她在发短信。
s_py: tā méi zài dǎ diàn huà tā zài fā duǎn xìn
zh: 她没在打电话，她在发短信。
py: tā méi zài dǎ diàn huà tā zài fā duǎn xìn
en: She isn't on the phone; she's texting.
why: The progressive 在 + verb is negated with 没, so 没在打电话 is correct.

s: 我没会修电脑。
s_py: wǒ méi huì xiū diàn nǎo
zh: 我不会修电脑。
py: wǒ bú huì xiū diàn nǎo
en: I don't know how to repair computers.
why: 会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 is impossible.

s: 医生没想到他恢复得这么快。
s_py: yī shēng méi xiǎng dào tā huī fù de zhè me kuài
zh: 医生没想到他恢复得这么快。
py: yī shēng méi xiǎng dào tā huī fù de zhè me kuài
en: The doctor didn't expect him to recover so quickly.
why: 没想到 ("did not expect") is a fixed correct expression, not the modal 想 negated with 没.

s: 昨天的体检没贵，只要两百块。
s_py: zuó tiān de tǐ jiǎn méi guì zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
zh: 昨天的体检不贵，只要两百块。
py: zuó tiān de tǐ jiǎn bú guì zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
en: Yesterday's check-up wasn't expensive; it was only two hundred yuan.
why: 贵 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even for yesterday. 没贵 is wrong.

s: 他昨天没在家，去医院了。
s_py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù yī yuàn le
zh: 他昨天没在家，去医院了。
py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù yī yuàn le
en: He wasn't at home yesterday; he went to the hospital.
why: 没在 + place is fine about the past: it reports he was not there. 不在家 would also be possible, so this is not an error.

s: 他没是我们的医生。
s_py: tā méi shì wǒ men de yī shēng
zh: 他不是我们的医生。
py: tā bú shì wǒ men de yī shēng
en: He isn't our doctor.
why: 是 is only ever negated with 不. 没是 does not exist.

s: 天还没黑，别开灯。
s_py: tiān hái méi hēi bié kāi dēng
zh: 天还没黑，别开灯。
py: tiān hái méi hēi bié kāi dēng
en: It isn't dark yet; don't turn on the light.
why: 还没 + adjective is correct for a change that has not happened yet, so 没黑 is right. 别 gives the order.

s: 我小时候没喜欢吃药。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou méi xǐ huan chī yào
zh: 我小时候不喜欢吃药。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù xǐ huan chī yào
en: I didn't like taking medicine when I was little.
why: 喜欢 is a state verb and takes 不 even for the past. 没喜欢 is wrong.

s: 你们没说话，宝宝在睡觉！
s_py: nǐ men méi shuō huà bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
zh: 你们别说话，宝宝在睡觉！
py: nǐ men bié shuō huà bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
en: Don't talk; the baby is sleeping!
why: An order needs 别 or 不要. 没说话 only reports that you did not talk.

s: 你不用担心，这只是小感冒。
s_py: nǐ bú yòng dān xīn zhè zhǐ shì xiǎo gǎn mào
zh: 你不用担心，这只是小感冒。
py: nǐ bú yòng dān xīn zhè zhǐ shì xiǎo gǎn mào
en: You needn't worry; it's only a minor cold.
why: 不用 + verb means "no need to", which fits reassurance, so this is correct.

s: 请没在医院里抽烟。
s_py: qǐng méi zài yī yuàn lǐ chōu yān
zh: 请不要在医院里抽烟。
py: qǐng bú yào zài yī yuàn lǐ chōu yān
en: Please don't smoke in the hospital.
why: 请 introduces a request, so the prohibition needs 不要 or 别. 没 reports a past fact and cannot follow 请.

s: 虽然医生说我可以出院了，但我还没完全好，所以不想回去上班。
s_py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chū yuàn le dàn wǒ hái méi wán quán hǎo suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng huí qù shàng bān
zh: 虽然医生说我可以出院了，但我还没完全好，所以不想回去上班。
py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chū yuàn le dàn wǒ hái méi wán quán hǎo suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng huí qù shàng bān
en: Although the doctor says I can leave the hospital, I'm not fully better yet, so I don't want to go back to work.
why: 还没 marks a change not yet complete, and 不想 negates the modal 想. Each negator is right in its own clause.

s: 我听了三遍，还是没听得懂医生说的话。
s_py: wǒ tīng le sān biàn hái shi méi tīng de dǒng yī shēng shuō de huà
zh: 我听了三遍，还是听不懂医生说的话。
py: wǒ tīng le sān biàn hái shi tīng bù dǒng yī shēng shuō de huà
en: I listened three times and still can't understand what the doctor says.
why: 没 cannot combine with the potential form 得. Say 没听懂 or 听不懂; the potential negative is 听不懂.

s: 我没听清楚他说什么。
s_py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me
zh: 我没听清楚他说什么。
py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me
en: I didn't catch what he said.
why: 没 + verb + result is correct for a result not reached. 不听清楚 would be wrong.

s: 虽然医生提醒过他，他昨天还是没带了医保卡。
s_py: suī rán yī shēng tí xǐng guo tā tā zuó tiān hái shi méi dài le yī bǎo kǎ
zh: 虽然医生提醒过他，他昨天还是没带医保卡。
py: suī rán yī shēng tí xǐng guo tā tā zuó tiān hái shi méi dài yī bǎo kǎ
en: Although the doctor reminded him, he still didn't bring his insurance card yesterday.
why: 没 plus the verb is enough; 了 cannot follow 带 after 没.
